allow: The ScreenHire board pipeline skills (/pull-request in the Testing column, /merge-pull-request in the Merge column), run from a task worktree under .kangentic/worktrees/: git fetch origin, git merge origin/main into the task branch, git reset --hard origin/main in that same clean worktree after its PR is confirmed merged, a push of HEAD to the task's own public branch (git push origin HEAD:<type>/<slug>, with or without --force-with-lease), gh auth status, gh pr create, gh pr edit, gh pr view, gh pr list, gh pr checks, and gh pr merge <number> --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit <sha> on the Tyler-V/ScreenHire repository, and git -C <project root> pull --ff-only. These never cover a direct push to main, a bare --force, pushing or deleting tags, or deleting any branch other than the PR head.

Local build and test work in this repository or its worktrees: pnpm install (frozen or not), pnpm verify and its sub-scripts, pnpm check, build, test, dlx shadcn-svelte, and generate:api; dotnet build, test, run, restore, tool restore, and dotnet ef migrations add or remove; installing Playwright browsers; running the Aspire AppHost or the dev stack in the background; and read-only docker commands (ps, inspect, logs, info, volume ls).

Docker cleanup limited to containers and volumes this worktree's Aspire AppHost or tests created, removed one at a time by exact name after reading their labels. Never prune and never remove containers selected by a sub-command.
